dataset.name: AMLCG intensively treated AML cohort (GSE106291)
dataset.description: Independent adult acute myeloid leukemia cohort with baseline bulk RNA sequencing and individual overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: The published validation cohort contains 210 patients enrolled in AMLCG-2008 and 40 additional resistant-disease cases from AMLCG-1999. The deliberate resistant-disease enrichment increases outcome prevalence and must be considered when interpreting absolute survival summaries; this cohort is independent of TCGA-LAML and the active OHSU repository cohort.

metadata.library_method: Poly(A)-selected paired-end bulk RNA-seq from baseline bone-marrow or peripheral-blood mononuclear cells
metadata.endpoint_context: Overall survival after AML study entry
metadata.redistribution_note: The GEO-processed matrix is analyzable in TRACE Explorer, but direct matrix redistribution remains disabled because GEO access alone does not resolve all submitter intellectual-property claims.
metadata.curation_note: All 250 GEO records contain positive overall-survival time, life status, age and sex. The source workbook contains 23,368 unique supplied gene labels; 1,966 features are NA for every sample and are excluded without imputation, leaving 21,402 complete numeric features. Fourteen legacy SEP/SEPT symbols were converted to dates in the XLSX file and are repaired by an explicit map verified against the pinned GSE106291 raw HTSeq archive (SHA-256 85032aa9fe049f9526a837aa447bb9eae7177de22883d6bed27fe622b188f664). The publication defines overall survival from study entry to death and generally censored analyses at stem-cell transplantation, but GEO does not expose transplant timing; TRACE Explorer therefore preserves the released time/status fields without additional transplant censoring.

samples.sample_role: Baseline AML bone-marrow or peripheral-blood mononuclear-cell specimen

expression.label: Published DESeq2-derived gene-scaled expression
expression.mapping_source: Gene labels supplied in the pinned GSE106291 workbook
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: The 23,368 supplied feature labels are unique both exactly and case-insensitively; no implicit feature aggregation is performed.
expression.scale_note: The source publication states that RNA-seq data were analyzed with DESeq2 and all gene-expression variables were scaled to mean 0 and variance 1. TRACE Explorer preserves the published values without a second transform. This cohort-standardized scale is not directly comparable with expression units from other studies.

endpoints.label: Overall survival
endpoints.event_definition: Death from any cause according to the released GEO life-status field
